name: Standard Export PO Terms
terms:
Standard Export PO Terms

1. Payment Terms: 30% advance payment upon order confirmation, 70% balance payment against shipping documents.

2. Inspection: Pre-shipment inspection by authorized agency or buyer's representative is mandatory.

3. Liquidated Damages (LD): Penalty of 0.5% per week of delay up to a maximum of 5% of PO value.

4. Warranty: 12 months from the date of commissioning or 18 months from the date of shipment, whichever is earlier.

5. ISPM-15 compliance: All wooden packaging material must be heat-treated and marked in compliance with ISPM-15 standards.

6. Force Majeure: Neither party shall be liable for delay or failure in performance due to acts of God, war, riot, or government regulations.

7. Governing Law: This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.
title: Standard Export PO Terms

name: Export to Africa Terms
terms:
Export to Africa Terms

1. Pre-shipment Inspection: SGS or Bureau Veritas inspection certificate is mandatory before loading.

2. Documentation: Clean Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Commercial Invoice, and Packing List are required for customs clearance.

3. Shipping: Shipment must be routed through approved shipping lines only.
title: Export to Africa Terms

name: Domestic India Terms
terms:
Domestic India Terms

1. GST Compliance: Supplier must upload invoices to the GST portal in a timely manner to enable Input Tax Credit (ITC) claiming.

2. Delivery: Door delivery to destination warehouse including unloading charges.

3. Payment: 30 days from date of receipt and acceptance of goods.
title: Domestic India Terms

name: LUT Certificate Terms
terms:
LUT Certificate Terms

1. LUT Applicability: This procurement is made under Letter of Undertaking (LUT) for export/zero-rated supply, drawing 0.1% IGST/GST.

2. Supplier Undertaking: The supplier must ensure all documentation references the valid LUT number of the buyer.
title: LUT Certificate Terms
